verdict.rationale: Pendo's built-in assistant Leo takes natural-language requests and acts on them by building guides and segments within the same conversation. It also monitors continuously and raises alerts, so it does delegated work rather than only answering questions. missing for 10: evidence beyond marketing pages (no in-depth docs on what Leo can do, its limits, or approval/review flows), the range of delegable tasks beyond guides, segments and monitoring, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
